newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Autoliv builds factory in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Autoliv builds factory in Thailand.

text.p: Swedish vehicle airbag and safety equipment maker Autoliv AB said on Thursday it was building a factory in Thailand with capacity to produce a million safety belts a year.
Autoliv said production of motor vehicles in Thailand was rising by about 10 percent a year, reaching 570,000 in 1995.
The company said in a statement that General Motors and Opel were currently building a factory in Thailand while Ford and Mazda have plans to expand their existing joint plant.
The Autoliv plant in Bangkok will cost about 20 million crowns ($3 million) to build.
-- Belinda Goldsmith, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017 ($ = 6.629 Swedish Crowns)
